Akapulko.description: Ringworm bush; leaves used traditionally for fungal skin infections.

Alagaw.description: Aromatic shrub used in folk medicine for cough and colds.

Aloe Vera.description: Succulent; leaf gel soothes skin and minor burns.

Banaba.description: Leaves brewed as tea; researched for blood sugar support.

Bignay.description: Tropical plant; leaves and fruits used in folk remedies and foods.

Bitter Melon.description: Vine with bitter fruit; used in cuisine and traditional medicine.

Calamansi.description: Citrus hybrid; juice used in drinks and home remedies.

Cassava.description: Starchy root crop; leaves and roots used in food (processed) and folk remedies.

Chili Pepper.description: Capsicum; pungent fruits rich in capsaicin.

Fukien Tea Tree.description: Ornamental shrub; leaves used in traditional teas.

Gotu Kola.description: Centella asiatica; used for cognition and skin support.

Guava.description: Leaves for antiseptic wash and diarrhea; fruits high in vitamin C.

Gumamela.description: Hibiscus; flowers/leaves used in folk remedies and teas.

Ipil-Ipil.description: Fast-growing tree; leaves/seeds used traditionally (caution advised).

Kakawate.description: Gliricidia sepium; leaves used as topical folk remedy and as shade tree.

Kamias.description: Bilimbi; sour fruit used in cooking and home remedies.

Lagundi.description: Vitex negundo; DOH-listed for cough and asthma.

Mango.description: Fruit tree; leaves used in folk decoctions; fruit is nutrient-rich.

Mayana.description: Coleus; colorful leaves, used topically in folk medicine.

Moringa.description: Malunggay; leaves rich in vitamins and protein.

Oleander.description: Ornamental shrub known to be toxic; not for ingestion.

Orange.description: Citrus fruit high in vitamin C; peel and leaves used in teas.

Oregano.description: Aromatic herb used in cooking and home remedies.

Pandan.description: Fragrant leaves used to flavor rice and desserts.

Peanut.description: Legume; seeds used for food and oil; leaves sometimes used in folk remedies.

Pomelo.description: Large citrus fruit; peel used in candies/tea.

Rose Balsam.description: Impatiens balsamina; leaves/flowers used in folk applications.

Saluyot.description: Jute mallow; leaves used as vegetable and in folk medicine.

Sambong.description: Blumea balsamifera; diuretic  and kidney support in folk medicine.

Soursop.description: Graviola; leaves and fruit used traditionally (research ongoing).

Stonebreaker.description: Phyllanthus niruri; traditionally used for kidney stones.

Sweet Potato.description: Root crop; leaves used as nutritious greens.

Tamarind.description: Pulp used as souring agent; leaves in folk remedies.

Tawa-Tawa.description: Euphorbia hirta; supportive folk use in dengue (not a cure).

Tuba-Tuba.description: Jatropha curcas; caution toxic; used externally in folk practice.

Turmeric.description: Rhizome rich in curcumin with anti-inflammatory properties.

Ulasimang Bato.description: Peperomia pellucida; used traditionally for joint discomfort.
